name: Posidonas
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Posidonas in Innsbruck**

Discover the authentic Greek flavors in the heart of the Alps! At **Posidonas**, we bring the sun, sea, and taste of Greece to **Tirol**. Indulge in our delicious **Gyros**, **Souvlaki**, and fresh **Tzatziki**, all made with love and the finest ingredients.

Our cozy restaurant invites you to relax after a day of exploring **Innsbruck** or the stunning **Tiroler Alpen**. Whether you're craving a hearty **Moussaka**, a crisp **Greek Salad**, or a sweet **Baklava**, we’ve got you covered.

Come taste the Mediterranean in the mountains—**Posidonas** awaits you! 🌞🇬🇷
